reason: A Feishu IM bridge for DeepSeek Harness that enables task control, notifications, streaming updates, and approval workflows through chat.

summaries.zh: 通过飞书即时通讯连接 DeepSeek Harness，支持任务指挥、状态通知、流式更新和审批交互。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Feishu for chat-based task control, status notifications, streaming updates, and approval interactions.

capabilities: Connects to Feishu through an official SDK long connection
Receives chat commands for starting, monitoring, stopping, and managing agent tasks
Sends notifications and streaming interactive card updates to Feishu
Presents approval requests through buttons or text and records approval audit events
Uses Feishu application credentials supplied through environment variables or local setup
